newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds need to rest around 101.00 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds need to rest around 101.00 area.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will ease back on Friday toward the 101.00 area after an exuberant session on Thursday, technical analysts said.

"It had quite a strong day yesterday, closing near the highs," Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London said. "In the near term, we're looking for a bit of a pullback to unwind the slightly overbought conditions. I'm looking for it pull back to the low 101.00s and base out there."
Bunds were quoted at 101.32 at 0648 GMT, down four basis points from Thursday when it shot 54 basis points higher helped by weaker than expected U.S. retail sales.
Wilkin said support in the 101.00 zone would come from the top of the previous range, including a high of 101.00 on June 6, a 101.10 high on June 9 and a 101.05 high on June 11.
He said once the contract was rested up again it could aim for top of the range at the May 14 101.55 high.
"If we fail to break up through there then we could start to form a top for a significant move lower," he said.

Technical analysts at Royal Bank of Scotland were positive on Bunds after Thursday's move. "Thursday's gains have boosted the strength of daily trend indicators so the bull leg is becoming more obvious," they said in a research note.

They put the near term target at around 101.70, 61.8 percent of the losses from May highs to June lows on continuation charts. "Market players should now be scaling into long positions with entry levels on pullbacks to 101.25 and 101.12," they said. "With good support at 101.03/04 and the value below, pullbacks today are not expected to significantly penetrate 101.00."
September Euromarks were at 96.85, unchanged in the session while December Euromarks were also flat at 96.76.
